text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Debut race. Biko Pegasus 
and her friends who race on dirt came by 
to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy was thrilled by all the 
attention. Fired up, she headed toward her 
debut race as the first step in taking 
over the racing world.
